verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Enter in, enter in
I am free to enter in

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
In His name, in His blood
In His spirit I come freely

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
To the throne of grace
And worship face to face

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
O praise the Living God
I am free, I am free to enter in
